name: Elec-Tech International Co., Ltd.
summary: Elec-Tech International Co., Ltd., alongside its subsidiary companies, functions as a manufacturer and distributor of compact household devices and a broad spectrum of LED products. Its operations span both domestic markets in China and international territories. The company's diverse product portfolio addresses various lighting requirements. This includes individual light source components such as LED bulbs, candle lamps, PAR lamps, straight tubes, and lamp cups. For interior environments, it provides an array of fixtures like spot, ceiling, and panel lights, alongside different ceiling, pendant, and down lamps. Moreover, their catalog features outdoor lighting solutions, encompassing decorative fixtures, streetlights, tunnel lights, yard lights, and specialized project lamps. Fundamental LED chips are also among its manufactured goods. These offerings are predominantly marketed under the company's proprietary ETi brand. Elec-Tech International Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Zhuhai, China.
